name: BTC vs ETH: Volatility & Returns Comparison
description: Cross-asset comparison of Bitcoin and Ethereum spot markets. Analyzes rolling annualized volatility (Yang-Zhang estimator), daily return distributions, and key risk-return statistics over the past ~2 years. Dashboard includes: rolling volatility time series, return distribution boxplot, per-asset return histograms, and a summary statistics table.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BTC vs ETH: VOLATILITY & RETURNS COMPARISON
# =============================================================================
# Compares Bitcoin and Ethereum spot markets on:
#   1. Rolling annualized volatility (Yang-Zhang, 30-day window)
#   2. Daily return distributions (boxplot + per-asset histogram)
#   3. Key risk-return summary statistics
#
# Assets: BTCUSD, ETHUSD (Coinbase spot)
# Timeframe: Daily
# =============================================================================

# --- Data Sources ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# --- Daily Returns (simple) ---
daily_ret = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.simple)(close)

# --- Rolling Annualized Volatility (Yang-Zhang, 30-day) ---
vol_30d = volatility_estimator(type=VolatilityEstimatorType.yang_zhang, period=30)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c)

# --- Cumulative Return (for summary stats) ---
cum_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Product)(1 + daily_ret) - 1

# --- Rolling 60-day Correlation (BTC vs ETH reference) ---
# Computed per-asset but shown in summary table as latest value

# --- Expanding Statistics for Summary Table ---
avg_daily_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(daily_ret)
expanding_std = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Std)(daily_ret)

# Annualize: avg return * 365 (crypto trades every day), vol * sqrt(365)
ann_ret = avg_daily_ret * 365
ann_vol = expanding_std * 19.105   # sqrt(365) ≈ 19.105

# Positive return rate: daily_ret > 0 → 1, else 0, then expanding mean
is_positive = 1 if daily_ret > 0 else 0
pct_positive = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(is_positive)

# --- Timestamps for cs_lines ---
bar_ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS
# =============================================================================

# 1. Rolling Annualized Volatility — BTC vs ETH over time
cs_lines(
    title='Rolling 30-Day Annualized Volatility (Yang-Zhang)',
    category='1. Volatility & Returns',
    y_axis_label='Annualized Volatility',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    order=1
)(bar_ts, vol_30d)

# 2. Daily Return Distribution — side-by-side boxplot
cs_boxplot(
    title='Daily Return Distribution: BTC vs ETH',
    category='1. Volatility & Returns',
    y_axis_label='Daily Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    show_outliers=True,
    order=2
)(daily_ret)

# 3. Per-asset histogram of daily returns
histogram(
    title='Daily Return Distribution',
    category='2. Return Histogram',
    bins=50,
    x_axis_label='Daily Return',
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    show_analytics=True,
    order=3
)(daily_ret)

# 4. Summary Statistics Table
cs_summary_table(
    title='Risk-Return Summary Statistics',
    category='3. Summary',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    order=4,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Annualized Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Annualized Volatility', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Cumulative Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='30d Vol (Latest)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Daily Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(title='% Positive Days', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    )
)(ann_ret, ann_vol, cum_ret, vol_30d, avg_daily_ret, pct_positive)
